blocks.text: Mammogram Screening near Lakeway TX at Victory Medical

blocks.html: As a woman life can be busy. Whether you are taking care of family, working, or maintaining your social calendar.
It’s a busy life. You feel good, so why should you worry about having a mammogram?

The answer? Because mammogram screenings save lives. And one of those lives may be yours. The focus of mammograms near Lakeway is to detect cancer in its earliest stages. Early detection is key for successful treatment.
So, while you have a minute, schedule a screening mammogram. Yes, it can be uncomfortable and maybe even a little awkward, but scheduling
a mammogram near Lakeway will give you the peace of mind you’re looking for.

blocks.text: Why is a Screening Mammogram near Lakeway Important?

blocks.html: Mammogram screening near Lakeway TX should begin at age 40 and every year after that, even if there are no risk factors.

Don’t put it off simply because you feel great. Especially if there are women in your family, who have been diagnosed with breast cancer in the past. You will want to pay attention to at what age that happened.
If your mother, for instance, was diagnosed with breast cancer at age 45, you will want to have your first mammogram at age 35.

It is extremely important to have a yearly mammogram near Lakeway. In fact, most physicians agree that having a mammogram screening is the best screening tool for early detection. A good mammogram can detect a problem before it has had a chance to become cancerous. That is a big deal.

blocks.text: Risk Factors You Should Know About

blocks.html: According to the CDC, there are risk factors for breast cancer you should be aware of. Most breast cancers are found in women who are 50 years of age or older.
A risk factor does not mean you will ever get breast cancer – and not all risk factors have the same effect.
Risk Factors You Cannot Change:

items: Personal or Family History of Breast Cancer

blocks.html: Risk Factors You Can Change:

items: Taking narcotics and overusing prescription or over-the-counter medication

blocks.html: The strongest risk factor is age. If you are between the ages of 45 to 54, you should be getting a mammogram every single year. And if you have a family member, such as your mother, sister, or daughter, who has been diagnosed with breast cancer, your risk factor nearly doubles.
If you are at all concerned about your level of risk, you should talk to your doctor about ways to reduce that risk including:

items: Taking medicines that reduce or block estrogen in your body.
If you have a strong family history of breast cancer or inherited changes in your BRCA1 or BRCA2 genes, you may want to consider surgery as well.

blocks.html: Most breast cancers begin in the breast tissue, which is made up of glands for producing milk. Or it can develop in the tubes which connect the glands to the nipple. Both instances can be detected during a mammogram screening near Lakeway TX before symptoms have even developed or after a woman notices a lump in her breast.

To understand all that such a diagnosis entails, you need to talk with your physician about your risk factors and to understand classic symptoms, plus what needs to be done in order for you to get back to your overall good health and well-being.
